beaucoup moins diététique !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}La {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}frutta{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} è ottima se mangiata
da sola, ma se vuoi un consiglio,
facci una {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}macedonia{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}L'aceto le dà un ottimo sapore,
{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}ma secondo me diventa ancora più
prelibata con del miele di {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}alveare{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ne serve solo un po'.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0002:}}Non vogliamo
mica che la macedonia si trasformi
in un dolce!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Obst ist auch ohne alles echt lecker.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Aber du solltest es trotzdem mal als
Salat probieren.
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Und in 'nen guten Salat gehört auch
Essig.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} Dazu noch etwas Honig aus
der {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Honigwabe{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Weltklasse!

{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Haha!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Vinegar {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}goes well on salads that use
a lot of different ingredients.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Its tangy flavor nicely fuses the 
flavors of the other ingredients!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Yeah! {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Vinegar {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}is great for {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}mixed
salads{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}There's no doubt about it,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}El {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}vinagre{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} va perfecto con
cualquier ensalada que use un
montón de ingredientes distintos.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}¡Ese sabor ácido y penetrante
hace que se fundan los sabores
de los demás ingredientes!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}¡Sí! ¡El {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}vinagre{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} es estupendo para
las {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}ensaladas mixtas{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡De eso
no hay ninguna duda, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Le {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}vinaigre{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ça marche surtout dans
les salades composées de beaucoup
d'ingrédients.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Son petit goût acidulé aide bien à
faire ressortir tous les ingrédients !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Bref,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} tu l'auras compris,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} pour faire
une bonne {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}salade terre et mer{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, il te
faut du {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}vinaigre{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} ! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}L'{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}aceto{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} è buonissimo sulle insalate
fatte con molti ingredienti.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Il suo gusto intenso amalgama
bene tutti i sapori!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Proprio così, l'{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}aceto{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} va alla grande
sulle {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}insalate miste{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Parola mia,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Essig {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}passt gut zu Salaten mit
verschiedenen Zutaten.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Der säuerliche Geschmack verbindet
die unterschiedlichen Zutaten erst
richtig miteinander!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Zum Beispiel passt er klasse zu
leckerem Herbstsalat!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Das solltest
du mal ausprobieren, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Sirke,{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} birçok farklı malzemeli
salataya çok yakışıyor{{TAG:0000:0004:}}. Ekşi
tadı diğer tatları güzelce
birleştiriyor{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}!{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}} Evet!{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} Karışık{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}
salatada{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} sirkenin üstüne yok, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}If you use plain fish in {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}fish salad{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, it
just ends up smelling fishy{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}So what you need to use is {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0020:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}lemon{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Lemon punches that fishy smell
right in the face! Amazing, isn't it?
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Don't forget! Fish plus salad plus
lemon equals knockout win!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Si usas el {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}pescado {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}a pelo en una
ensalada, al final la ensalada
huele demasiado fuerte{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Por eso, ¡lo que tienes que usar
es un poco de {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0020:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}limón{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡El limón se libra del olor del
pescado como yo me libro del sudor
del entrenamiento con una ducha!
¿Lo has pillado? ¡Ensalada, pescado
y limón son la mejor combinación!
¡Recuerda esta rima,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Si tu te mets simplement du poisson
dans ta salade, elle risque de plus
sentir le poisson qu'autre chose{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Mais pour parer à ça,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} heureusement
qu'il y a le {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0020:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}citron {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Avec ses petits bras musclés,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} il
t'attrape les odeurs de poisson par
le col et te les envoie à perpette !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Alors n'oublie pas !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Salade +
poisson + citron = des narines et un
estomac heureux, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Un piatto a base di solo {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}pesce {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}corre
il rischio di odorare troppo
di{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}. pesce.
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Quello che ti serve in quei casi
è del {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0020:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}limone{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Il limone prende a pugni quella puzza
e la mette al tappeto! Forte, eh?
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
Pesce più insalata più limone
sono la scelta vincente!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Wenn du einfach nur Fisch im Salat
hast, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}gibt's diesen aufdringlichen
Fischgeruch{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Darum sollte man auch 'nen Spritzer
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0020:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Zitrone {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}dazugeben!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Das verjagt den fiesen Fischgeruch!
{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}Toll,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} oder, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Merk dir: {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}Fisch plus Salat plus
Zitrone ergibt 'ne Geschmacks-
goldmedaille!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Dishes with {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}mushrooms {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}are great
this time of year, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}A nice bisque with a few kinds of
mushrooms served nice and warm {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
can be delicious!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Throw in a chunk of {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}butter{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}and
boom! Food master in the house!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}En esta época no entra mal
un plato con {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}champiñones{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Preparas una crema y le echas
unos champiñoncitos troceados.
¡Luego lo sirves todo calentito!
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Pero además si añades un poquito
de {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}mantequilla{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}} ¡Zas, ya tienes
ahí algo pero que muy potente!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Si toi aussi t'aimes les {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}champignons{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
tu dois savoir qu'on est en plein
dans la saison, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}On va pouvoir à nouveau se faire
péter le bide à coup de{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} crème de
champignons !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Je te conseille d'y ajouter une noix
de {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}beurre{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}} Crois-moi, tes papilles
ne vont pas en revenir !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}In questo periodo dell'anno, è
impensabile non mangiare {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}funghi{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Una bella zuppa con dentro
diversi tipi di funghi{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} può
essere una vera bontà!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Se poi ci aggiungi un po' di {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}burro{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}BUM! Fate largo allo chef!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Pilzgerichte sind genau das Richtige
im Herbst, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Für 'ne leckere, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}heiße Cremesuppe
mit ein paar Pilzen mach ich auch
mal 'ne Trainingspause!
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Wenn du dann noch ein Stückchen
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Butter {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}dazugibst{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}} bist du mein
Ober-Sportass für alle Zeiten!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Soup with {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}clams {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}reminds me of 
seaside clambakes. It's so good!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}But if you toss in a little {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}butter{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, 
the soup is even more delicious!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Clams and butter, clams and butter.
It's the ultimate combination of
awesome ingredients, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}La {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}crema de almejas {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}me hace
pensar en la última mariscada rica
a la que me invitaron. ¡Qué delicia!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Pero la cosa es que si le echas
un poquito de {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}mantequilla{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},
¡el resultado es aún mejor!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Almejas y mantequilla, almejas
y mantequilla. ¡No olvides esa
combinación, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}La {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}soupe de coquillages{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ça me
rappelle les barbecues en bord de
mer !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} C'est trop bon !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Ajoutes-y une noisette de {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}beurre{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
et ta soupe devient un véritable
délice !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Coquillages et beurre,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} beurre et
coquillages{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}. {{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Je suis prêt à célébrer leur mariage
sous mon palais autant de fois qu'ils
le souhaitent, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Le creme vellutate con
i {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}frutti di mare {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}mi ricordano le belle
grigliate fatte in spiaggia!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Io le adoro, soprattutto se dentro
ci si mette un po' di {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}burro{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Frutti di mare e burro, burro e
frutti di mare... Che fantastica
combinazione, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Bei {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Muschelcremesuppe{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} sind erst
mal bloß Muscheln im Wasser –{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
so weit, so langweilig.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Aber tust du etwas {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Butter{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} dazu,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
wird's 'ne richtig leckere Sache!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Muscheln und Butter sind zusammen
die ultimative Mischung für 'ne
Weltklassesuppe, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Midyeli{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}} çorba{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} bana sahil
mangallarını hatırlatıyor{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}. Çok
güzel! Biraz{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}} tereyağı{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} atarsan
daha da nefis{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0003:}} olur. Midye ve
tereyağı, midye ve tereyağı...
Efsane malzeme ikilisi, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Fish {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}soup tastes delicious and has a
nice consistency to it. I love it!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}The key is adding just a squeeze of
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}lemon{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}. It gets rid of that fishy odor
and goes down nice and easy.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡La {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}sopa de pescado{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} está deliciosa
y tiene una consistencia muy
interesante! ¡Me encanta!
Está muy buena por sí sola, pero
he notado que a mí me gusta mucho
más con un chorrito de {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}limón{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}La {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}soupe du pêcheur {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}est délicieuse
en plus d'être nourrissante,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} j'en
raffole !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Mon truc, c'est d'y ajouter un zeste
de {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}citron{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} histoire que ça sente pas
trop fort et que ça passe mieux !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Le zuppe di {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}pesce{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} sono proprio
buone, vero?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Per renderle ancora più buone,
basta aggiungere un po' di {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}limone{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}La puzza di pesce va via
e resta solo il sapore!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}An Fischsuppe mag ich diese
Mischung aus Brühe und kleinen
Fischstückchen!
Wenn du dann noch den Fischgeruch
mit 'nem Spritzer {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Zitrone{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} loswirst,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
schmeckt sie unschlagbar gut!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Balık{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} çorbası hem lezzetli hem
kıvamlı; bayılırım!{{TAG:0000:0004:}} Kilit nokta
biraz limon{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}} sıkmak{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}. Balık
kokusunu alır, içimi kolaylaşır.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Fruit {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}is a really great base for soup!
{{TAG:0007:0001:}}Plus, I just like the sound you get
when you boil fruit!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}And if you add just a squeeze of
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}lemon{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, you get a nice citrus kick
that makes it really tasty!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}La {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}fruta{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} está rica hasta hecha sopa,
por raro que te parezca.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} ¡Y me
encanta el ruido que hace al hervir!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Y si le añades un puntito de {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}limón{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},
¡le da un toque cítrico que hace
que quede aún mejor!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Faire une soupe à base de {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}fruits{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} on
dirait pas comme ça,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} mais c'est
super bon !
De toute façon, une soupe ne peut
jamais être mauvaise ! Que ce soit
au goût ou pour la santé !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Mon petit truc,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} c'est d'y ajouter un
zeste de {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}citron{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} une fois la cuisson
terminée,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ça rend super bien !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Hai mai aggiunto della {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}frutta {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}a una
minestra? Provaci!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} Io adoro anche
il rumore che fa quando bolle!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Per un sapore ancora più intenso,
basta aggiungere qualche goccia
di {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}limone{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Obst und Suppe sind füreinander
gemacht{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} wie Hanteln und Muskeln
oder Fuß und Ball!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Und wenn du dann noch 'nen Schuss
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Zitrone{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} dazugibst, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}schmeckt das wie
die Kür nach der Pflicht!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Meyve{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} çorba için harika temel{{TAG:0007:0001:}}!
Bir de kaynarken çıkan sese
bayılıyorum!{{TAG:0003:0001:}} Azıcık limon
sıkınca{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}} narenciye{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} vuruşu geliyor
ve iyice güzelleşiyor!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}If you add sweetness to hot dishes,
it tones down the spiciness and just
makes them all-around delicious!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}For example, {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}coconut {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}in {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}tom yum
kung {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}makes for a perfect
combination, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}But you need to go diving for the
freshest-possible lobster to make
good {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}tom yum kung{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}It's quite a chore, {{TAG:0003:0026:}}but it's totally
worth it because it's so good!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Si le añades un toque dulce a un
plato picante, parece como que
pica un poco menos y sabe mejor.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Por ejemplo, la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}sopa de bogavante{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}
queda genial con {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}coco{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}. ¡Te lo digo
yo, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Pero hay que hacer submarinismo
para conseguir un bogavante con el
que preparar la sopa{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
Sí, es una lata, {{TAG:0003:0026:}}pero viendo
el resultado... ¡te aseguro
que vale totalmente la pena!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Un sapore dolce nei piatti piccanti
riduce il gusto forte e armonizza
il tutto.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ad esempio, un po' di latte di {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}noce
di {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}cocco {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}nella {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}zuppa di aragosta {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}è

{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Mir war ja gar nicht richtig klar,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}wie verrückt die Leute hier nach
Essen sind!
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Und ich hab heut viel übers Kochen

TRANSLATION:
Hasat{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}} Festivali bitti{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} demek, ha?
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}} Bugün farklı malzemeler
hakkında çok şey öğrendim{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}.

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Oye, he comido demasiado!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
Tras el Día del Pavo, es que podría
pasarme unos meses hibernando.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}¡Pero no caerá esa breva! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Porque
tengo un apetito insaciable... ¡por
el deporte!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:001A:}}Pero antes, un paseo.
Si me pongo a correr directamente
con la panza así de llena, ¡sé que
voy a acabar echando la pota!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Pfiou !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Je crois que j'ai trop
mangé !{{TAG:0007:0001:}} Si je m'écoutais,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} j'irais
hiberner un mois ou deux.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Mais qu'est-ce que je dis ?! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}Je ne
dois pas céder à la paresse !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Mes muscles ont faim à leur tour,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
faim d'efforts !{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:001A:}}Mais avant ça,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} je
vais faire une promenade digestive{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Heiliger Flatterball! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}Ich bin tierisch
überfressen!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Nach dem {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Herbstfest{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}
könnt ich immer Winterschlaf halten.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Aber daraus wird nichts! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Ich muss
ja auch noch meinen Hunger nach
Sport stillen!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Aber vielleicht tut's erst mal auch

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Today's event was like the
championships of eating!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}I ate a ton!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}} But I can't tell if I'm
winning or losing, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Hoy ha habido una prueba
deportiva, ¡el campeonato
de ponerse hasta las trancas!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}¡He comido una barbaridad!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}} Pero
en esta competición, por una vez,
¡todos ganamos, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Aujourd'hui, on se serait cru aux

{{TAG:000E:000A:0600640065002000040064002700}}{{TAG:0005:0005:}} !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Je me suis vraiment surpassé !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}} Mais
